name: StepError
description: DataBend's media-failure errors, one decision per tempo step. X = chance a step corrupts, Y = how deep the damage goes (hold, crush, dropout, CD skip). Hold the pad to engage; release is dry.

params.name: PROB
params.detail: Chance each step fires a data error

params.name: ERR
params.detail: Error depth: bit-rot, stuck samples, dropouts, skip window

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the pad is held

params.name: KIND
params.detail: Error flavor: ALL, HOLD, CRUSH, DROP, SKIP
